title: Griddle is perfect for making pancakes, omelettes, & crepes; this one heats just slightly unevenly
text:
Griddle is perfect for making pancakes, omelettes, & crepes; this one heats just slightly unevenly. This is my third crepe maker. In March 2011, I purchased [[ASIN:B001EZCJL8 Cucina Pro Non-Stick 12" Crepe Maker]] on Amazon for $44.42. Then a year or two ago I ordered my favorite crepe maker -- the [[ASIN:B07822Z42M Proctor Silex 38400 Electric 13" Crepe Maker / Griddle]] (no longer available) -- because the Cucino Pro felt too small and seemed more like 10" instead of 12".

Nevertheless, once I discovered I could make omelettes on these, I wanted another one so that I have the option of having two going at the same time.

This Chefman 12" is large enough and comparable in size to my Proctor Silex. It comes with one SMALL wooden crepe spatula and one wooden batter spreader. The tools are not so great but they are good enough. I personally am unable to make any crepe, omelette, etc. without using two crepe spatulas simultaneously.

I decided to make a 4-egg omelette on this griddle. I lightly greased the surface with coconut oil, then turned the dial up to max as recommended. Once the green light came on, I turned the dial to about medium and poured my omelette mix out. After about one minute the egg was partially cooked (photo 1). When it cooked some more, I added my stuffings. I then folded over the sides and corners and let it cook some more. Once I had a neat package, I used two wooden crepe spatulas (one of which was mine) to flip it. The entire process took less than seven minutes. The last picture shows it plated.

This Chefman is good enough for the price. However, there are two things I do not like. First, the unit does not cook evenly. If you look at my photos, the upper right-hand corner is a bit uncooked compared to the lower left-hand corner. The issue is rather minor but it is obvious to me. My counter is level so it is the griddle itself. Second, the dial feels very flimsy and cheap. I feel it will break after lots of use.

One the positive side, it gets the job done. The tools are a starter set only and likely new ones will have to be purchased after a short time. The unit is low profile so it takes up less space when stacking in a cabinet.

product_metadata.title: CHEFMAN Electric Crepe Maker: Precise Temp Control, 12" Non-Stick Griddle, Perfect for Crepes, Tortillas, Blintzes, Pancakes, Waffles, Eggs, Bacon, Batter Spreader & Spatula Included, Black
features: GET BRUNCHIN : Skip the brunch lines and whip up delicious café-quality crepes right at home. With the Chefman Electric Crepe Maker and Griddle you can quickly and easily make crepes, blintzes, pancakes, omelets, hash browns and many more breakfast favorites. This multi-functional crepe pan also doubles as a griddle, so you can use it day or night. Breakfast, brunch, lunch or dinner will be easier and more fun than ever.

PERFECTLY PRECISE: Powerful 1000-Watt heating element with a precise temperature control knob gives you consistently delicious and even results every time. Light up power feature indicates that your crepe maker is heating up, while green indicator light illuminates when it has reached desired cooking temperature. Includes free batter spreader and spatula for perfect distribution and easy crepe creation.

SAVES TIME AND EFFORT: Large cooking area makes it easy to create restaurant style crepes in your own kitchen. Simply preheat the crepe maker, spread a thin layer of batter, and watch your crepe cook in seconds. Use the included batter spreader and spatula for perfect distribution, smooth texture, and easy flipping.

NON-STICK SURFACE: The cooking surface is non-stick, so no scraping or mess. To clean, simply wipe down the surface with a damp cloth until food residue is removed. Allow the appliance to cool before cleaning. Its flat design makes storing it easy- though we doubt you ll ever want to put it away.
